name: texttools
description: The 2.11BSD text tools ported together run, from a staged script so the needles are outputs and never the typed command: printf joins `pf' and 42; tail -2 and rev reverse `bravo' and `zulu9'; split's second piece, tee's file and comm's one common line reversed; tsort's last item reversed; expand's tab made visible with tr; unexpand's leading blanks folded to a tab that od -c spells; sum's 2.11BSD checksum of the 18-byte file (48226, computed on the host from sum.c's loop); dd's first six bytes (a line) reversed and its record count; du -a naming a file split created.  dd's needles went red with BIG left at 2147483647 (`dd: argument 1 out of range').
